title: DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program
institution: DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program (Berliner Künstlerprogramm des DAAD)
about: The DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program offers residency fellowships for 2028: 12 months in literature and in music & sound, 6 months in film. Applications close 15 December 2026, 23:59 CET. For 2028 the single collective fellowship is in music & sound.
requirements: Open applications only in literature, music & sound, and film; visual arts candidates are nominated by a jury
Artists residing primarily in Germany are generally excluded
German nationals living abroad must show at least six years of primary residence in the country they apply from
card_alt: Card for the DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program fellowship from the DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program (Berliner Künstlerprogramm des DAAD), Berlin, Germany, deadline 15 Dec 2026. The photo shows Cologne Cathedral and the Hohenzollern Bridge at night in Cologne, not Berlin.
